role: Independent integrator spot checks following the existing-coverage audit; the three domain logs contain the broad and focused searches and assignable reading scopes.
queries: site.kernel.org cgroup v2 cpu.stat io.stat memory.peak documentation
site.gcc.gnu.org Instrumentation Options fstack-usage fprofile-generate address sanitizer
site.sourceware.org gdb watchpoints optimized code debugging documentation
site.clang.llvm.org docs AddressSanitizer detected bugs limitations
site.nist.gov McCabe cyclomatic complexity structured testing NIST SP 500-235 PDF
site.usenix.org AddressSanitizer fast address sanity checker 2012 Serebryany paper

checks.scope: Core controller/delegation concepts and distinction between configurable resource limits and observed accounting.
checks.decision: Retain separate configuration, membership, accounting and measurement claims; no-root observation and delegated experiments need different gates. Exact assigned interface scopes belong in T43 source records.

checks.scope: Profile generation/use and sanitizer build requirements.
checks.decision: Require instrumented and uninstrumented artifacts and matching training/use configurations. Instrumentation results cannot be treated as the original binary's cost.

checks.scope: Developer diagnostics as a lead for stack-usage output; domain author must pin the exact assigned option and version.
checks.decision: Keep per-function compiler estimates separate from whole-system stack bounds and sampled watermarks.

checks.scope: Hardware watchpoint resource constraints and software watchpoint limitations.
checks.decision: A missing watchpoint capability is an observation limit, not evidence that corruption cannot occur.

checks.scope: Source-to-machine differences and removed variables in optimized debugging.
checks.decision: Teach learners to retain exact binary/debug information and reason from actual instructions when source stepping diverges.

checks.scope: Detected memory-error classes, platform qualification and instrumentation memory/stack overhead.
checks.decision: A clean diagnostic run closes only the selected tool/configuration/executed-path claim. Bug demonstrations must not promise a prescribed undefined-behavior symptom.

checks.scope: Separate uninitialized-value detector and instrumentation boundary.
checks.decision: Do not teach ASan as a universal uninitialized-read detector; preserve separate tools and supported-platform routes.

foundational_leads.decision: Sent the official NIST structured-testing report to T43 author for bounded inspection if needed; bibliographic discovery alone adds no reading assignment.
Corroborated publisher/author/year of ASan2012 with T45 author; historical benchmark overhead is not a prediction for a present tool/build/workload.

limits: Web spot checks are corroborating review evidence, not broad library search or a new assignable locator registry. Search results from secondary discussions were not used as technical authorities. Live pages can change; domain resources retain exact inspection and version/access-date limits. No learner program, profiler, debugger or target board was executed in this review.
